Title: [Deck] All your base are belong to us!, or Harbingers of Skulls try to play your game.

Messages.Author: Pepijn
Messages.Body:
Hi there again,

I'm rather bored at work, so I keep on develloping new decks for the
storyline event. Let's de-construct this concept. I want to add more
vulnerabilities, but I only have 2, so no need to tell me to add
more.. I know I should add more...:(

The vbasic concept is to burn weenies with Anisa, and uncontrolled
vamps with Gisela. The restorations are their to get blood back since
these burn actions are expansive.

Get the burned opponents to my side with Deamonic possesion, and use
Agaitas to play my preys deck against him.

The two "spares" are Ian, for obvious reasons, and Kanimana basicly
just for her ability. Plus point of the two is that the both posses
DOM and AUS, and therefor make ideal deflectors/blockers (with
obedience).

Ex nihilo is in to provide for a better way for the specials of either
Anisa, Gisela or Kanimana to work. Summon soul is there to cycle back
usefull cards, all depending on the type of game.

Here goes nothing:

2 Agaitas for AUS NEC 6
2 Anisa Marianna Lopez aus FOR NEC QUI 8
2 Egotha obf AUS FOR NEC 7
